zoe: Deploying the Cloudflare Workers quickstart fails with: 'ReferenceError: process is not defined' and later 'Error: Cannot find module "net"'. We only use fetch + JWT verify. Any quick fixes?

karen: Most likely a transitive dep pulled in node builtins (buffer/net/fs). Which jwt library? Many helpers bring in buffer for base64. Quick fixes: 1) switch to a web-first verifier using WebCrypto, 2) set esbuild/wrangler target to service-worker to avoid auto-polyfills, 3) use a tiny opt-in shim for explicit worker-safe helpers.

matt: For what we ship internally we created a small package pattern: `@redwood/inference-edge-shims` that is opt-in and tiny. It exports: `verifyJwt(webKey, sig, payload)`, `safeFetchWithAuth(url, opts)`, and `nodeBuiltinStubs` that throw a clear error linking to docs. Publish with conditional exports so worker builds get `*.worker.mjs` and node gets cjs/esm.

karen: Minimal WebCrypto guard we recommend putting in the shim: ```js
export function ensureImportKey(){
  if (typeof globalThis.crypto?.subtle?.importKey !== 'function'){
    throw new Error('WebCrypto.importKey not available in this runtime. See https://go.redwood.dev/edge-crypto')
  }
}
```
This gives a clear fast-fail with guidance.

matt: Auth/retry nuance for Workers: avoid parallel refresh storms. Store the refresh Promise on globalThis and reuse it. Pseudocode: ```js
async function refreshOnce(){
  if (globalThis.__RW_REFRESH) return globalThis.__RW_REFRESH
  globalThis.__RW_REFRESH = (async ()=> { try { return await doRefresh() } finally { globalThis.__RW_REFRESH = null } })()
  return globalThis.__RW_REFRESH
}
```
Then on 401 do one refresh, update header, and allow 1-2 exponential backoff retries with jitter.

zoe: This helps a lot. Can we add a short onboarding note in the sample README listing: node builtins, webcrypto caveats, esbuild target, and tsconfig tips? New hires keep hitting this.

devx-bot: Draft PR opened to add `@redwood/inference-edge-shims` and update the quickstart README. CI will add a Miniflare job to run worker-targeted tests.
